newsitem.title: CHINA: China Mastercard's second largest market in world.
newsitem.headline: China Mastercard's second largest market in world.

text.p: China has become Mastercard International's second largest market in the world after the United States, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Mastercard had issued 15 million cards in China by end-March this year, Xinhua said, quoting the latest figures.
On Wednesday, Mastercard signed an agreement with Shanghai Golden Card Project, linking its global ATM network with more than 1,000 membership machines in Shanghai, Xinhua said.

Andre Sekulic, vice chairman of Mastercard for the Asia-Pacific region, was upbeat about the Chinese market, with an increasing number of foreign tourists visiting China and more Chinese travelling abroad, the news agency said.
Mastercard opened its third China office in Shanghai recently. It also has offices in Beijing and Hong Kong, which reverted to Chinese rule on July 1.

Mastercard's members in China include the country's four major state banks -- the Bank of China, the China Construction Bank, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and the Agricultural Bank of China -- and new commercial banks, such as the Bank of Communications, the Guangdong Development Bank and the Merchants Bank.
